name: Audit weekly-report ownership shapes across test fixtures
description: Inventory weekly-report seeds and mocks against their production writer ownership contract so supporter- and supportee-shaped rows cannot mask read-scope regressions.
acceptanceCriteria: Every weekly-report fixture and mock is classified as self-report-shaped or supporter-digest-shaped with its production writer cited; misleading shapes are corrected or explicitly named; direct tests prove the intended list and exact-link reader; weak shared-record consumers cannot stay green solely because recap or milestone facts remain.
